title: 什么是生物风险管理：关键要素与重要性

author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/41_What is Biorisk Management Key component Importance Biosafety Biosecurity labora/src.py

points.K4: 重点：病原体、毒素、转基因生物
points.K5: 目的：保护健康、环境和国家安全
points.K6: 生物安全涉及的领域很广
points.K13: 为什么重要：防实验室感染
points.K16: 负责任研究，管好两用研究
points.K17: 生物安全与生物安保的区别

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼门口，身旁浮着一面带生物危害标志的盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a microbiology lab building, a floating shield with a biohazard symbol beside it, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：什么是生物风险管理。
overlay: 什么是生物风险管理：关键要素与重要性

shots.scene: 阿杰在课题组例会上举手，面前是一张空白通知
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand at a group meeting, a blank notice sheet on the table in front of him.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：生物风险管理，是不是就是填表？

shots.scene: 老周笑着摇头，指向实验室里的人、柜子和冰箱
shots.prompt_en: The older man smiles, shakes his head and points around the lab at people, a biosafety cabinet and a sample freezer.
shots.narration: 老周说：它管的是人、材料和每一步操作。

shots.scene: 四个问号卡片排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four blank cards in a row, each with a question mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 我们分四个问题来回答。

shots.scene: 四个圆形图标连成一圈：放大镜、天平、盾牌、仪表
shots.prompt_en: Four round icons linked in a loop by arrows: a magnifying glass, a balance scale, a shield and a gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 生物风险管理是一个过程：

shots.scene: 小研拿放大镜看培养皿，再在空白表上打分
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks at a petri dish through a magnifying glass, then marks a blank rating form.
shots.narration: 先找出风险，再评估它有多大，

shots.scene: 小研关上安全柜视窗，抬头看墙上的空白仪表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lowers the sash of a biosafety cabinet, then glances at a blank gauge icon on the wall.
shots.narration: 然后降低风险，并持续盯住它。

shots.scene: 三个图标：手套拿试管、冰箱、灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a gloved hand holding a test tube, a locked sample freezer and an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 管的是生物材料的处理、储存、处置。

shots.scene: 一支样本管从冰箱到安全柜再到灭菌器，箭头相连
shots.prompt_en: A sample tube icon travels by arrows from a freezer to a biosafety cabinet to an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 从拿到手到最后销毁，每一环都要管。

shots.section_title: 重点：病原体、毒素、转基因生物
shots.scene: 三个图标：微生物、小瓶带骷髅、DNA 双螺旋
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a microbe, a small vial with a skull pictogram and a DNA double helix. No people.
shots.narration: 重点是病原体、毒素和转基因生物。
overlay: 重点：病原体、毒素、转基因生物

shots.section_title: 目的：保护健康、环境和国家安全
shots.scene: 三层同心圆：人、山水、国家盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Three concentric circles: a person icon in the center, a landscape icon in the middle ring and a large shield in the outer ring. No people.
shots.narration: 目的是保护人的健康和环境，
overlay: 目的：保护健康、环境和国家安全

shots.section_title: 目的：保护健康、环境和国家安全
shots.scene: 外圈盾牌亮起
shots.prompt_en: The outer shield ring lights up brightly. No people.
shots.narration: 也关系到国家安全。

shots.section_title: 生物安全涉及的领域很广
shots.scene: 六格轮盘，中心生物危害标志，每格一个图标
shots.prompt_en: A wheel with six segments around a central biohazard symbol, each segment with one icon: microbes, a virus near a person, DNA, a mask, a microscope and a fish. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全涉及的领域很广：
overlay: 生物安全涉及的领域很广

shots.section_title: 生物安全涉及的领域很广
shots.scene: 轮盘上方三格亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three upper segments of the wheel light up: microbes with a lightning bolt, a virus near a person, and DNA strands. No people.
shots.narration: 病原检测与杀灭、重大传染病、遗传资源，

shots.section_title: 生物安全涉及的领域很广
shots.scene: 轮盘下方三格亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three lower segments light up: a protective mask, a microscope and a fish crossing a border line. No people.
shots.narration: 防护用品、实验室安全、外来物种入侵。

shots.section_title: 生物安全涉及的领域很广
shots.scene: 欣欣指着轮盘中的显微镜一格
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the microscope segment of the wheel.
shots.narration: 我们这课聚焦实验室这一格。

shots.scene: 两个齿轮咬合：一个带绿十字，一个带锁
shots.prompt_en: Two interlocking gears: one with a green cross icon, one with a padlock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它是一套系统方法，把两件事合在一起：

shots.scene: 小研戴手套在安全柜里操作，身边绿十字图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works with gloves inside a biosafety cabinet, a green cross icon floating beside her.
shots.narration: 生物安全，防的是意外接触；

shots.scene: 带锁的样本冰箱，门禁闪绿灯
shots.prompt_en: A locked sample freezer and a door access panel with a green light. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安保，防的是故意滥用。

shots.scene: 四个齿轮：绿十字、锁、天平、领队旗
shots.prompt_en: Four interlocking gears with icons: a green cross, a padlock, a balance scale and a small flag. No people.
shots.narration: 伦理和领导力，也是齿轮的一部分。

shots.scene: 五格拼图，第一格亮起：放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A five-piece puzzle; the first piece lights up with a magnifying glass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 管理体系有五个组成。第一，风险评估。

shots.scene: 小研在空白评估表上写，旁边微生物和人体图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills in a blank assessment form; a microbe icon and a human outline float beside it.
shots.narration: 找出有害的生物因子，评估可能的影响。

shots.scene: 拼图第二格亮起：盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The second puzzle piece lights up with a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，风险缓解，把风险压到最低。

shots.scene: 三个图标：安全柜、手套护目镜、空白规程本
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a biosafety cabinet, gloves with goggles, and a blank procedure binder. No people.
shots.narration: 靠防护设施、个人防护和标准规程。

shots.scene: 拼图第三格亮起：仪表
shots.prompt_en: The third puzzle piece lights up with a gauge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，绩效监测：措施真的管用吗？

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白检查表巡查实验室
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks through the lab holding a blank checklist on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 靠审核和检查来验证，

shots.scene: 检查表上一项打叉，箭头指向扳手图标后变成勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with one red X; an arrow leads to a wrench icon and then to a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 发现问题，就采取纠正措施。

shots.scene: 拼图第四格亮起：讲台
shots.prompt_en: The fourth puzzle piece lights up with a small lecture podium icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第四，培训与意识。

shots.scene: 王老师给阿杰和小研讲课，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches the young male student and the female graduate student in a small classroom with a blank screen.
shots.narration: 学会安全操作、应急程序，

shots.scene: 天平图标浮在学员上方
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale icon floats above the seated trainees in the classroom.
shots.narration: 也要懂科研伦理。

shots.scene: 拼图第五格亮起：文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The fifth puzzle piece lights up with a folder icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第五，记录与报告。

shots.scene: 四个空白文件夹，各带图标
shots.prompt_en: Four blank folders in a row, each with an icon: a warning triangle, a box, a binder and a graduation cap. No people.
shots.narration: 事件、库存、规程、培训，都有记录。

shots.section_title: 为什么重要：防实验室感染
shots.scene: 一个人形图标被微生物包围，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A person outline surrounded by microbe icons, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 为什么重要？首先，防实验室获得性感染。
overlay: 为什么重要：防实验室感染

shots.section_title: 为什么重要：防实验室感染
shots.scene: 阿杰洗手后摘下手套，表情轻松
shots.prompt_en: The young male student washes his hands at the lab sink after removing gloves, looking relaxed.
shots.narration: 在实验室里工作，不该把病带回家。

shots.scene: 实验楼外是居民区和河流，楼外加一圈防护罩
shots.prompt_en: A lab building with a transparent protective dome, outside are houses, trees and a river. No people.
shots.narration: 其次，保护公众和环境，

shots.scene: 两条红色箭头试图冲出防护罩，被挡住
shots.prompt_en: Two red arrows try to leave the protective dome and are blocked at its edge. No people.
shots.narration: 不论意外还是蓄意，都不让有害因子外泄。

shots.scene: 一本国内法规书和一本国际指南并排
shots.prompt_en: Two closed books with blank covers side by side, one with a shield icon and one with a globe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，符合国家和国际法规。

shots.scene: 国际指南旁边一张标准卡片
shots.prompt_en: A blank international guideline book next to a blank standard card. No people.
shots.narration: 比如国际组织指南、CWA 15793。

shots.section_title: 负责任研究，管好两用研究
shots.scene: 一个试管图标两侧各一个箭头：一侧救护，一侧红色警示
shots.prompt_en: A test tube icon with two arrows: one to a medical cross icon, one to a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 第四，负责任地做研究。
overlay: 负责任研究，管好两用研究

shots.section_title: 负责任研究，管好两用研究
shots.scene: 老周和小研审看空白课题书，旁边天平图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student review a blank project proposal together; a balance scale icon floats nearby.
shots.narration: 可能被滥用的两用研究，要事先审查。

shots.section_title: 生物安全与生物安保的区别
shots.scene: 两列对照表，左绿十字，右锁
shots.prompt_en: A two-column comparison board: a green cross icon on the left, a padlock icon on the right, rows left blank. No people.
shots.narration: 安全和安保，到底怎么分？
overlay: 生物安全与生物安保的区别

shots.section_title: 生物安全与生物安保的区别
shots.scene: 台面上一个培养皿打翻，液体流出
shots.prompt_en: A culture plate tipped over on a lab bench with a small spill. No people.
shots.narration: 安全看的是意外，比如培养物洒了。

shots.section_title: 生物安全与生物安保的区别
shots.scene: 样本冰箱门半开，盒子空了一格，红色问号
shots.prompt_en: A sample freezer door ajar with one empty slot in a rack and a red question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 安保看的是故意，比如病原被盗用。

shots.scene: 三本空白封面的参考书并排
shots.prompt_en: Three reference books with blank covers stand side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 可参考三个国际框架：

shots.scene: 三本书依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The three blank reference books light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 安全手册、CWA和ISO标准。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现识别、评估、缓解、监控四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four floating icons: a magnifier, a scale, a shield and a gauge.
shots.narration: 生物风险管理：识别、评估、缓解、监控。

shots.scene: 五格拼图拼成完整
shots.prompt_en: The five puzzle pieces join into one complete square. No people.
shots.narration: 评估、缓解、监测、培训、记录，五块拼齐。

shots.scene: 绿十字和锁两个齿轮咬合
shots.prompt_en: Two gears with a green cross and a padlock turn together. No people.
shots.narration: 安全防意外，安保防故意。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰站在实验室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye at the lab door with a biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 管住风险，安心做实验，下次见！
